what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/get-there: route buttons for a trip, and the nearest places of a brand or name.

payload.label: Route buttons for a trip
payload.job: Give one-tap buttons that open the route to a place in each maps app, from a start and through stops on the way
payload.description: Give destination, and optionally origin, stops (places on the way) and mode. Answers one button per maps app, each { id, label, url }. Pure: it reaches no network. A new maps app is a row in read-data/get-there.json.

destination.description: An address or place name as words, or { lat, lon }, or { address }

origin.description: An address or place name as words, or { lat, lon }, or { address }

items.description: An address or place name as words, or { lat, lon }, or { address }

mode.description: How to travel; drive when left out

provenance.source: the app's getting-there module, with its maps and places services as DATA

payload.label: Find the nearest places of a brand or name
payload.job: Find the nearest stores or places of a brand or name around a start, each with route buttons
payload.description: Give name (a brand or a place name) and near (an address or place name as words, or { lat, lon }), and optionally radius_km, most and mode. Reads the open address and places services the settings name, tries the other copies of the places service when one is busy, and answers the nearest places first with their address, distance, opening hours and route buttons. A service that does not answer is told in words, never guessed around. The settings are in read-data/get-there.json.

near.description: An address or place name as words, or { lat, lon }, or { address }

radius_km.description: How far to search around the start; the settings' default when left out

mode.description: How to travel; drive when left out

provenance.source: the app's getting-there module, with its maps and places services as DATA
